summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines a service called 'counter' built from the current directory. It sets up a named volume called 'counter_data' that persists data in a '/data' directory inside the container, so the data survives when the container restarts.

explanations.5: The '%%name=counter%%' syntax is a template variable that gets replaced with the value 'counter' — it's used here to give the service a dynamic name that can be changed in one place.
explanations.12: This mounts a Docker-managed volume named 'counter_data' into the container at the '/data' path, allowing the container to read and write persistent data that won't be lost when the container stops.
explanations.17: This defines 'counter_data' as a named volume that Docker will manage for you — think of it as a labeled storage container that can be reused and survives independently of the running container.
